title: The Signature Food Pantry Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Student food resources, opening hours, and access requirements. The Food Pantry Database records food pantries and food resources serving students: locations, opening hours, access requirements, what identification or enrollment proof is needed, and any limits on visits. Records note additional services such as fresh produce days or meal programs. The Signature side adds visit guides covering what to expect and what to bring.

Document required identification or enrollment proof
Note visit limits and additional services
Provide visit guides for first-time users
Track hour changes by term
